correctness.rationale: With positive allowed flip rates and n≥3, a frozen set contains no pair with a common neighbor, whether or not either site can itself flip. The distinct endpoints of non-returning two-step walks are T^{±1}v and T^{±2}v for T(r,i)=(1−r,i+1); repeated edges cause no change, including at n=4. T closes after lcm(2,n) steps, so the relevant graph is one squared 2n-cycle or two squared n-cycles. Marking a selected position counts each labeled k-set k times and yields (m/k) binom(m−2k−1,k−1) for 1≤k≤floor(m/3). This also proves the stated degree deficit. The weighted transition 1→2 forces 2→3→1 before another selection; the all-zero cyclic word has exactly the constant path at 1. Thus the trace is the cycle polynomial, and the primitive matrix gives the stated limit at z>0. Independent Bernoulli weights give the exact tilt and the inequality ρ(z)<1+z makes the log rate strictly negative. The supplied verifier was inspected as text and its recorded finite calculations are corroboration only; the all-size proof does not depend on them.
